score_batch_of_translations: score a batch of translations using SequenceScorer.generate with an ensemble of fairseq models
compute_token_level_log_probs: compute token-level log probabilities for target sequences using SequenceScorer with a single model
extract_attention_alignments: extract hard alignments from model attention weights by setting compute_alignment to True in SequenceScorer
score_with_ensemble_models: score translations using an ensemble of models by passing multiple models to SequenceScorer.generate
batch_softmax_for_memory_efficiency: batch softmax computation for large sequences by setting softmax_batch in SequenceScorer to limit memory usage
